integrity: Standalone checker performs exact finite orbit-face enumeration, mod-two boundary-rank comparisons and signed Lefschetz checks; full all-graph claim follows from explicit proof rather than the finite tests.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple graphs; fixed space under canonical layer swap of a prism, not the entire perfect-matching complex; non-equivariant homotopy classification and integral base-automorphism homology module only. Unindexed equivalent prior work remains possible.
title: Geometric layer-fixed topology of prism perfect-matching complexes
